The whole model on one line.src: The whole model on one line

This is @@T0@@makemore@@T1@@ in miniatur.zh: 这是@@T0@@makemore@@T1@@的微缩版：词表包含 $8$ 个字符，上下文取最近 $B = 3$ 个字符，嵌入维度为 $d = 2$，含一个宽度为 $6$ 的隐藏层。每一次预测都走同一条短流水线：
This is @@T0@@makemore@@T1@@ in miniatur.src: This is makemore in miniature: a vocabulary of $8$ characters, a context of the last $B = 3$ characters, an embedding dimension of $d = 2$, and one hidden layer of width $6$. Every prediction is the same short pipeline:

The weights below are small fixed number.zh: 下方的权重是一些固定的小数字（一个未经训练的网络），因此整个运行过程完全可复现。我们的例子：上下文是 @@T0@@v e e@@T1@@，真实的下一字符是 @@T2@@n@@T3@@ —— 即「Na v e e @@T4@@n@@T5@@,」的末尾，也就是名字 Naveen。请逐步走一遍。
The weights below are small fixed number.src: The weights below are small fixed numbers (an untrained net), so the run is fully reproducible. Our example: the context is v e e and the true next character is n — the tail of “Na v e e n,” the name Naveen. Step through it.

Press @@T0@@Step@@T1@@ to advance the pi.zh: 按下 @@T0@@步进@@T1@@ 推进流水线，或用编号按钮跳转到任意阶段。下方那条细带标示你所在的位置；再下面的面板则完整地绘制出该阶段。
Press @@T0@@Step@@T1@@ to advance the pi.src: Press Step to advance the pipeline, or jump to any stage with the numbered buttons. The strip below tracks where you are; the panel underneath draws that stage in full.

The current stage, drawn with live numbe.zh: 当前阶段，以实时数值绘制。
The current stage, drawn with live numbe.src: The current stage, drawn with live numbers.

@@T0@@Prob of true char &lsquo;n&rsquo;@.src: Prob of true char ‘n’ —

@@T0@@Watch stage 6.@@T1@@ The gradient.zh: @@T0@@留意第 6 阶段。@@T1@@ logit 上的梯度恰好就是 $p - y$：真实字符 ‘n’ 上有一根负的柱子（要把它推高），其余各处都是正的柱子（要把它们压低）。把它反向追溯，便抵达嵌入表 —— 但只有第 @@T2@@v@@T3@@ 与第 @@T4@@e@@T5@@ 行亮起。其余六行在这一步从未被索引到，因此它们的梯度恰好为零。
@@T0@@Watch stage 6.@@T1@@ The gradient.src: Watch stage 6. The gradient on the logits is exactly $p - y$: one negative bar on the true character ‘n’ (push it up) and positive bars everywhere else (push them down). Trace it back and it reaches the embedding table — but only rows v and e glow. The other six rows were never indexed this step, so their gradient is exactly zero.

Every large language model, underneath,.zh: 每一个大语言模型，在其底层所做的正是你刚刚逐步走过的这些 —— 只不过更宽、更深，并且用注意力取代了单次的拼接操作。其骨架并未改变：
Every large language model, underneath,.src:
Every large language model, underneath, is doing what you just stepped through — only wider,
      deeper, and with attention in place of a single concatenation. The skeleton is unchanged:

@@T0@@Embed@@T1@@ each context token int.zh: @@T0@@嵌入@@T1@@：通过索引一张表 $E$，把每个上下文词元变为一个向量。
@@T0@@Embed@@T1@@ each context token int.src: Embed each context token into a vector by indexing a table $E$.

@@T0@@Mix@@T1@@ the context (here: conca.zh: @@T0@@混合@@T1@@：把上下文（在此：先拼接，再过一层 $\tanh$）合并为一个隐藏状态。
@@T0@@Mix@@T1@@ the context (here: conca.src: Mix the context (here: concatenate, then one $\tanh$ layer) into a hidden state.

@@T0@@Sparse updates.@@T1@@ Because embe.zh: @@T0@@稀疏更新。@@T1@@ 由于嵌入本质上是一次查表，一个样例的梯度只会修改它所用到的那几行。在整份语料上，共享上下文的字符（或词）会被推向相似的方向并一同漂移 —— 这正是嵌入的几何结构最终变得有意义的原因。嵌入 → MLP → softmax，以 $p - y$ 作为评判：这就是学习预测下一词元的全部思想。
@@T0@@Sparse updates.@@T1@@ Because embe.src: Sparse updates. Because embeddings are a lookup, one example’s gradient only edits the rows it used. Over a whole corpus, characters (or words) that share contexts get nudged in similar directions and drift together — which is exactly why the embedding geometry ends up meaningful. Embedding → MLP → softmax, graded by $p - y$: that is the entire idea of learning to predict the next token.

meta.title: 字符级 MLP 语言模型，逐步详解
meta.tagline: 一步步走过一个微型字符级 MLP 的一次前向与反向传播
meta.summary: 一个 makemore 风格的字符级 MLP，被剥离到只剩骨架：8 个字符的词表、3 个字符的上下文、二维嵌入、一个 tanh 隐藏层。按下步进，让一个训练样例依次经过嵌入、拼接、隐藏层、softmax、交叉熵损失与反向传播——所有数值都以固定、可复现的权重实时绘制在画布上。结尾把下一词元学习变得具体可感：梯度 p - y 反向流动，且只修改该样例实际用到的那两行嵌入。
highlights: 逐步走过一个微型字符级 MLP 的完整一次前向与反向传播，一阶段一阶段地看，配以实时数值。
清晰地看到整条流水线：嵌入 → 拼接 → tanh 隐藏层 → softmax → 交叉熵 → 反向传播。
观察上下文「v, e, e」（来自名字 Naveen）恰好点亮嵌入表的哪两行——「e」被用了两次，其梯度会累积。
把 softmax 读作一幅柱状图，标出真实的下一字符「n」，并看到损失 -log p_true 作为一个大数字呈现。
下一词元预测的点睛之笔：梯度 p - y 只更新被查询过的那些嵌入行；其余每一行的梯度都恰好为零。
